name: jev
description: TypeSafe Jev through Vercel AI Gateway. Fast structured decisions and screenshot-free UI action selection for Grok Bot.

interface.shortDescription: Use TypeSafe Jev via Vercel AI Gateway instead of slow screenshot computer use.
interface.longDescription: Runs the jev-ultrafast loop on the Bot computer: snapshot live DOM nodes, ask TypeSafe Jev on Vercel AI Gateway (typesafe-ai/jev), click that node. Call fast_web_task instead of screenshot computer use. On TYPE_TEXT, write the string and call fast_web_fill. Requires AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY and Playwright Chromium.
defaultPrompt: Use fast_web_task for web work. Do not screenshot-click.
If status is need_text, write the field value from the goal and call fast_web_fill.
Open example.com with fast_web_task and stop when the heading is visible.
